title: Prove sharp q-ary point-column faithfulness widths (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped mathematical proof with exact finite corroboration. For q=p^e and arbitrary payload coefficients of characteristic p, the least faithful widths of the diagonal point-column group-algebra action are:

```text
                         d >= 2      d = 1, q > 2      d = 1, q = 2
GL_d(F_q)                   d              1                  0
AGL_d(F_q)                d + 1            2                  1
```

This extends ywz65's binary-only [PR2599](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2599). The affine-line exception for q>2 needs a new multiplier-coset annihilator: its two coset sums are the same all-ones operator on one point, although their formal difference is nonzero. A literal two-dirty-role F3 word is identity at width one and exposes six basis columns at width two. No new kappa is claimed.

The result is produced by Nick Petalas. Credit ywz65 for the binary threshold and regular-orbit/norm method and its separate PR2629 formalization, woklerx for the finite-address bridge, Gareth Davidson / PR1333 for formal-versus-represented scope, and Josie Elliston / Hanson Sun for the census context. The group-action methods are classical; no literature-wide priority is claimed. No predecessor executable or scientific census was replayed.

## Evidence

Before: the retained sharp threshold covered binary point columns. After: PROOF.md proves the defining-characteristic statement for every prime power and every dimension, including explicit nonzero annihilators below threshold and the complete dirty witness.

Local normal and optimized verification pass on CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64. The fixed checks enumerate 15 group fixtures, 853 group elements across fixtures, 158 below-threshold addresses, 12 full line-action spans and 1,465 field triples. Separate formal and literal alias replays cover all 24 dirty basis columns across widths one and two. Fourteen controls challenge separation, coefficient characteristic, the coset relation, field validity, six omitted ADDs, dirty-input coverage and source drift. Every check remains active under optimization.

Exact commands from the worktree root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qary-stream-faithfulness
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/qary-stream-faithfulness/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/qary-stream-faithfulness/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/qary-stream-faithfulness --check-source-history
```

On another machine, substitute its CPython 3.12 executable for the absolute path. Expected output is PASS_QARY_STREAM_FAITHFULNESS, PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE and PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES. Both registered commands were timed separately below 0.1 second locally, below their 60-second limits. This is a timeout check, not a performance claim.

The committed-byte/source-history check passes for head 7ed20e7e701135a25171e064e180b8dfb47aa433 and base 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a. Official package export and declared-input integrity checks pass. A read-only Git-free optimized replay produces the identical generated, hash-bound JSON receipt. No receipt was handwritten and no generated replay output is committed.

## Limitations

The full arbitrary payload space, common translation across columns and defining coefficient characteristic are explicit premises. This is a written proof with finite corroboration, not independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance. It supplies no native or physical caller, complete recursive invoice, supplier admission or selected-frontier change. All five selected framework assumptions remain. Selected cold, Lean, Docker and predecessor scientific replays were unrun.

## Open next questions

- Can one named nonbinary native caller realize the action with a completely paid dirty boundary? Start with its encoding and legal operations, then charge conversion, restoration and the complete invoice. No such caller is supplied.
- What is the full annihilator ideal of the single-point affine-line action? Start from the enumerated spans and seek a universal presentation. The coset obstruction does not classify the kernel or prove a general image-rank formula.

## Related open work

No open PR studying these q-ary point-column faithfulness widths was located in the checked live titles/bodies and complete cached open-PR snapshot. The merged PR2599 is the binary predecessor; merged PR2620 concerns binary target-call minima, and merged PR2629 supplies a distinct binary kernel-checked interface. None is being audited or claimed as a new result here. Sparse notes, unpublished work and arbitrary historical diffs remain overlap limits.
